title: 材料与装置词汇
goal: 辨认材料与装置词汇，理解部件之间的功能关系。

points.label: 辨认材料与装置的常用词
读懂部件之间的功能关系

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 材料与装置词汇的教学内容

body.p: 材料性质说明一种物质在某种条件下怎样表现，例如吸水、导热。装置由多个部件组成，各部件分别负责连接、控制或传递。
读装置说明时，分清三样内容：输入的东西、各部件的功能、最后的产物。能量转换指一种能量变成另一种能量，例如机械能变成电能。

body.box: A demonstration filter receives cloudy water in an upper chamber. Water passes through a layer of sand and then through a mesh into a lower container. The sand holds back some particles; the mesh supports the sand. The lower container collects the water that has passed through both layers. The demonstration does not establish that the collected water is safe to drink.

body.p: upper chamber 接收输入的水。sand 截留部分颗粒，mesh 支撑沙层，lower container 收集流出的水。
collected water 是装置的产物。原文只说沙层截留部分颗粒，没有说收集到的水可以饮用。

groups.fill: This device carries water through a narrow pipe. A va{lve} controls t{he} flow wh{en} the pu{mp} is swit{ched} on; a fil{ter} removes so{me} particles fr{om} the wa{ter} before i{t} reaches a tank. The tank collects water after it has passed through the filter. Its cover limits the entry of larger objects. The valve can be closed to stop the flow while the filter is being replaced. The diagram identifies the pipe, the tank and the removable filter as separate parts.
notes: the：the flow 指管道内的流动。
from：from the water 表示颗粒的来源。

groups.text:
A small model moves air with a fan. The fan is inside a casing, and a mesh covers its inlet. Air passes through the mesh before reaching the fan. A switch controls the fan's motor. The outlet directs air away from the casing.

Side view
            (1)
      ┌──────────────┐
air → │ ▒    ✺ (2)   │ → (3)
      └──────────────┘
▒ marks the mesh over the inlet; ✺ is the internal rotating part; (1) is the shell around them.

items.stem: Complete label (2) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是图下说明 the star represents the internal rotating part。外壳里旋转的部件是 fan。

items.stem: Complete label (3) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是 The outlet directs air away from the casing。(3) 在空气离开外壳的一侧，即出口。

items.stem: Complete with ONE WORD from the passage: The inlet is covered by a _____.
items.why: 依据是 a mesh covers its inlet，盖住入口的是网。

items.stem: Complete with ONE WORD from the passage: The motor is controlled by a _____.
items.why: 依据是 A switch controls the fan's motor，控制电机的是开关。

groups.fill: A generator changes mechanical energy into electrical energy. A ro{tor} turns ins{ide} a cas{ing} while mag{nets} move ne{ar} coils o{f} wire. Th{is} movement c{an} induce a cur{rent} in t{he} coils. The generator requires an external source of motion. A turbine, for example, can turn the rotor through a shaft. The casing surrounds the moving parts, while the wire carries the resulting current towards a circuit. Each part has a different role in the conversion of energy, and the diagram records the links among them.

groups.text:
A classroom demonstration uses moving water to turn a small turbine. The device is a model for observing energy transfer; it is not designed to supply a building. Water enters through an inlet at the upper end of a channel. The channel directs the flow towards the turbine, whose blades turn when the water pushes against them. A transparent cover lets observers see the blades while keeping splashes inside the model.

The turbine is connected to a shaft. As the blades rotate, the shaft turns with them and drives a small generator. Inside the generator, motion produces an electric current. Wires carry the current to a lamp, which lights while sufficient current flows. The lamp provides a visible indication of the circuit's operation, although its brightness alone does not measure the total energy entering the device. Some energy is transferred to the surroundings as heat and sound during operation.

After passing the blades, water leaves through a lower outlet and enters a collection tank. A pump returns it from the tank to the inlet so the demonstration can continue. The pump has its own power supply. The model therefore uses an external input to keep water circulating; it does not generate a continuous supply of energy by itself. The instructor can stop the pump and observe that the flow gradually ceases. The lamp then goes out as the turbine stops turning. Each component has a distinct function: directing water, transmitting rotation, producing current or collecting the outflow. Following those connections helps explain why an interruption at one point affects later stages.

Model: water and energy transfer
Inlet → channel → (1) ✺ → (2) ━ → [generator] → wires → (3) ◉
　　　　　　　　　↓
　　　　　　　outlet → (4) ▣
The star is the rotating device; the horizontal bar connects it to the generator. The circle is the light-producing component; the lower box collects water.

items.stem: Complete label (1) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是 the turbine, whose blades turn when the water pushes against them。图中星形是旋转的装置，即 turbine。

items.stem: Complete label (2) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是 The turbine is connected to a shaft。图中横杆把涡轮机连到发电机上，即 shaft。

items.stem: Complete label (3) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是 Wires carry the current to a lamp。图中圆形是发光的部件，即 lamp。

items.stem: Complete label (4) with ONE WORD from the passage.
items.why: 依据是 water leaves through a lower outlet and enters a collection tank。图中下方收集水的方框是 tank。

items.stem: Complete with ONE WORD from the passage: A _____ returns water to the inlet.
items.why: 依据是 A pump returns it from the tank to the inlet，把水送回入口的是泵。
